founders.note: Hi Ankit, I'm following SALT's work in cross-border payments. As a dev who built RoundUp, an open-source UPI expense tracker, I love fintech innovation. Would love to connect.
founders.followup: Thanks for connecting, Ankit. I've been fascinated by how SALT simplifies complex compliance and treasury management for cross-border businesses. Building my own open-source UPI tracker, RoundUp, gave me a taste of payment workflows, but global compliance is a whole other level. What has been the most interesting engineering challenge you've solved while scaling SALT?
